name: @khorsheed/dsh-client-ui-panel-kit
description: Shared client-side panel kit for community sidebar panels: the --dsh-panel-* type tokens with desktop defaults, a container-query panel root, and the compact controls every panel shares (header with an overflow menu, underline tabs, filter chips, list rows). Consumed at the SOURCE plane — each plugin's tsdown client bundle inlines it — never mounted as a plugin row.

compat.notes: A source-plane library, not a plugin: it registers no slot, service, locale or row, and owns no client bundle of its own. Consumers declare it as a workspace dependency and import `@khorsheed/dsh-client-ui-panel-kit/src/client/*` directly, so tsdown inlines the kit into each plugin's own `lib/client.js` — zero runtime coupling and nothing to install alongside them. Its official-host surface is one runtime import, ui-primitives' `Menu` (the header's overflow list, present since the 0.1.5-rc.1 line, the same import ui-content-preview carries); icons are inlined artwork. Type sizes are `--dsh-panel-*` custom properties always read with a desktop fallback, so a panel renders identically with or without `@khorsheed/dsh-mobile`, which only raises the values on touch screens. Spec: proposal panel-responsive-spec (2026-10-06).
